title: Crab folds its eyestalks

source.source_title: Aransas and Matagorda Island National Wildlife Refuges
source.why_this_clip: A pale ghost crab fills the frame facing the camera on sand and works its two claws up to its mouth, raising the left claw highest around 6.75 s. The crab shot starts after the cut at 5.25 s and runs to the end of the clip; earlier shots show a horned lizard and a raccoon.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected16raw source samples spanning the retained interval and boundary margins in preflight-source.jpg. One continuous event; no internal cut/dissolve observed.

assembly_summary: The same native eleven-stroke crab lowers both claw constructions and spreads its four drawn leg reaches over the visible sand. Two separately credited agent eyestalk strokes preserve the observed brief eye-fold event.
